description:
Run ONE backup now (via the INSTALLED script). dry_run shows the bash;
    confirm executes. Non-destructive to prod (read-only pg_dump).

    Whatever `backup_setup` put in that script is what runs - including the off-site copy to
    object storage, if it was enabled. This tool deliberately does NOT take off-site arguments
    of its own: a second recipe here could drift from the nightly one, and then "I ran a backup"
    would stop meaning "the nightly job would have done this". To change the off-site settings,
    re-run `backup_setup`.
name: backup_run
